itens.titulo: Coca-Cola Joins Costco in the $400 Billion Club. I Predict Only 1 of These Dividend Stocks Will Surpass $1 Trillion by 2036.
itens.descricao: Coca-Cola Joins Costco in the $400 Billion Club. I Predict Only 1 of These Dividend Stocks Will Surpass $1 Trillion by 2036. Yahoo Finance
trechos: Thanks to KO stock's year-to-date 34% rally to record highs, the beverage behemoth's market cap has just eclipsed the $400 billion mark, moving within sight of Costco's $440 billion.
Coca-Cola is simply extending a long-lived growth trend that puts it on track to eventually join the $1 trillion club.
Only one of these dividend payers has a realistic shot at getting there within the next 10 years, however.
In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia.
For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia.
Its stock is also an income juggernaut, not only paying a quarterly dividend like clockwork for decades now, but raising its dividend payment for 64 consecutive years.
Even with this ticker's recent gains, newcomers will be plugging into a respectable forward-looking yield of 2.3%.
For its market cap to reach $1 trillion by 2035, its stock would need to gain 250%.

itens.titulo: Is Meta Platforms Stock a Buy as Revenue Continues to Soar?
itens.descricao: Is Meta Platforms Stock a Buy as Revenue Continues to Soar? Yahoo Finance
trechos: In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia.
For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia.
Continue » Meta delivers 26% revenue growth in Q3 The biggest reason to own Meta stock is that it has been one of the best companies at using AI to drive growth in its core business.
This was evident again in Q3, when revenue grew 26% to $64.6 billion, beating the $63.37 billion consensus, as compiled by LSEG.
Adjusted EPS, excluding a large legal settlement, came in at $7.40.
That easily surpassed the $5.75 consensus.
Meta's advertising revenue jumped 26% to $63.1 billion, while other revenue climbed 59% to $1.1 billion.
Revenue at Reality Labs, which is home to its reality headsets and smart glasses, fell 6% year over year to $443 million.

itens.titulo: Último pregão antes das eleições tem digestão do Datafolha e IPCA-15; Ibovespa em dólar cai nesta sexta-feira (23)
itens.descricao: Último pregão antes das eleições tem digestão do Datafolha e IPCA-15; Ibovespa em dólar cai nesta sexta-feira (23) Money Times
itens.texto:
Último pregão antes das eleições tem digestão do Datafolha e IPCA-15; Ibovespa em dólar cai nesta sexta-feira (23)
Os investidores começam o último pregão antes do segundo turno de olho na mais recente pesquisa Datafolha, publicada na noite de ontem (22). Para esta sexta-feira (23), a redução da diferença entre os candidatos deve dar o tom dos negócios.
A pesquisa do Instituto Datafolha apontou o senador Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) empatado com o presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT), com ambos registrando 50% dos votos válidos.
Vale lembrar que no levantamento anterior do Datafolha, publicado na última quinta-feira (15), Flávio contava com 51% dos votos válidos contra 49% de Lula. Ainda hoje, às 21h20, acontece também o último debate presidencial na TV Globo entre os candidatos antes do pleito.
Além disso, no panorama local, os investidores ainda aguardam a publicação dos números do IPCA-15. A prévia da inflação brasileira deve avançar 0,36% em outubro, segundo a mediana das projeções do Broadcast.
Lá fora, a temporada de balanços corporativos continua a todo vapor, com os investidores monitorando de perto a possível desaceleração do mercado de inteligência artificial. Ao mesmo tempo, o avanço dos preços do barril de petróleo limita os ganhos dos principais índices hoje.
Mercado brasileiro
Ibovespa: A três dias do segundo turno das eleições, o aumento da incerteza eleitoral contaminou o apetite ao risco local e o Ibovespa (IBOV) teve mais um pregão negativo. A piora do humor global com a disparada dos preços do petróleo para o nível acima de US$ 110 por barril e a preocupação com IA também pressionaram.
Nesta quinta-feira (22), o principal índice da bolsa brasileira terminou as negociações com queda de 1,15%, aos 204.120,12 pontos.
Já o dólar à vista encerrou o dia a R$ 5,0394, com alta de 0,23%.
O iShares MSCI Brazil (EWZ) — principal ETF brasileiro negociado em Nova York — cai 0,26%, cotado a US$ 41,74.
Mercados internacionais
As bolsas asiáticas fecharam o pregão majoritariamente em alta, a exceção do Japão. Na Europa, os principais índices começam o dia em baixa e os futuros de Nova York caem hoje.
- Petróleo: Os preços do petróleo sobem hoje.
- Criptomoedas: O mercado de criptomoedas oscila hoje.

itens.titulo: Big Tech's capex spending looks different this year as Meta and Tesla save for later
itens.descricao: Big Tech's capex spending looks different this year as Meta and Tesla save for later Yahoo Finance
trechos: Longer-term, off-balance-sheet spending plans of $825 billion for Meta and a $100 billion chip plant estimate for Tesla upended all the goodwill on Thursday — sending markets into a tizzy.

A gauge of Meta's credit risk surged to a new record and its bonds sank, Bloomberg reported, after the company said it would spend about $825 billion in the future on computing power, AI infrastructure, and other commitments.
Meanwhile, Elon Musk said the chip plant Tesla is building with SpaceX will need tens of billions of dollars in equipment through early 2028 and likely more than $100 billion over the long term.
The company is sitting on its cash pile and watching its peers pour hundreds of billions of dollars into AI tech, proving the point in reverse.

itens.titulo: How Elon Musk went from Tesla CEO to the 'most powerful civilian, non-governmental actor in history'
itens.descricao: How Elon Musk went from Tesla CEO to the 'most powerful civilian, non-governmental actor in history' Yahoo Finance
trechos: Across the last few years, however, the centi-billionaire's growing portfolio of businesses has pushed him into a new lane entirely.

"There's a very real chance that [Musk] is the most powerful civilian, non-governmental actor in history," Gautam Mukunda, a research fellow at the Harvard Kennedy School and managing director of the consultancy Two Rivers Group.
'Extraordinary power' SpaceX is now responsible for roughly 90% of all mass sent into orbit off Earth, Musk said on SpaceX's recent earnings call.
"He can turn a country's communications on or off — that's an extraordinary power," Darrell West, senior fellow at the Brookings Institution's Center for Technology Innovation, told Yahoo Finance.
"Even governments can't do that."

"Bears are already calling that the first hyperscaler capex cut, but Tesla has no cloud to sell and no contracted capacity to walk away from.
